source: Measured natively for version 0.2 (the rig: camera head angle, video latency, 5/10 mm instruments; generator endosim-procedure/0.3), on 2026-11-26 on the tree of 582152e4: tests/review/run_native.py (tests/verify.py's grade and score, the same hidden set, sessions, probes, budgets, renderer and canary; only the two launchers differ) ran the reference controller (solution/reference: privileged tips, scope, camera head angle and latency in place of perception and identification; rate commands through the public wire) on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/procedures.json: 12 procedures x 800 steps with the rigs drawn by tests/review/draw_rigs.py), Isaac Sim 6.2.0.0 rendering on an RTX 6000 Ada (driver 570.195.03, not a cloud-listed GPU model, shared with other jobs). useful_view_fraction 0.8760417 (8410 of 9600 steps; per procedure 0.879 0.850 0.914 0.916 0.794 0.855 0.790 0.933 0.876 0.928 0.911 0.868), probe pairs 172 of 604 differing (the lock's fraction is 0.1), no aborted procedure, no lens contact, no restart. The reference reads the simulator's state and never the picture, so the value does not depend on the renderer, but it depends a little on which steps are probed: over ten draws of the probes the render-free loop (tests/review/fast_eval.py's sessions) gave 0.8752 to 0.8759. full_at 0.98: the spread over probe draws is below 0.1 %; the margin also covers a threshold flipped by rounding on another CPU (the numerics are not pinned). Version 0.1's anchor was 0.903 (ale validate validate-3f6c0b60); version 0.2 has not been through ale validate yet, and the validate's oracle value replaces this one. Status: tests/README.md section 7.
